name: tests-e2e-ng
description: End-to-end tests for Angular application and API

scripts.test:smoke: npx cross-env CI=true TEST_CATEGORY=smoke API_PORT=5172 ANGULAR_PORT=4200 DATABASE_PATH=test.db API_URL=http://localhost:5172 ANGULAR_URL=http://localhost:4200 BYPASS_AUTHORIZATION_FOR_E2E=true E2E_TEST_MODE=true playwright test
scripts.test:critical: npx cross-env TEST_CATEGORY=critical API_PORT=5172 ANGULAR_PORT=4200 DATABASE_PATH=test.db API_URL=http://localhost:5172 ANGULAR_URL=http://localhost:4200 BYPASS_AUTHORIZATION_FOR_E2E=true E2E_TEST_MODE=true playwright test
